problem.title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
problem.problemStatement: Each balloon is represented by an interval on a number line. One arrow shot vertically bursts every balloon intersecting that point. Determine the minimum number of arrows required to burst all balloons.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines contain the start and end coordinates of each balloon.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of arrows.
